headline: Colombia Advances Royalty Budget Bill for 2027-2028 Biennium
summary: Colombia's bill for the 2027-2028 biennium royalty budget, equivalent to 1.4 percent of GDP, advanced to its second debate amid lower resource availability.
why: National royalty budget proposals dictate regional infrastructure funding and resource-rent distribution in resource-dependent emerging economies.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Lower resource availability in the 2027-2028 royalty budget impacts regional spending allocations.
